content.headline: Platform engineer
content.subject: Calm releases and observable services for your platform team
paragraphs: Your posting asks for someone who can make releases boring and incidents rare. That is the work I have done for the last three years at Example Corp, where I designed the deployment pipeline every product team now uses.

You list observability, PostgreSQL and on call experience. I built the metrics stack at my previous company, moved the billing services to managed Postgres, and ran the reviews after each outage, turning every finding into a tracked change.

I work in small steps that can be reviewed and rolled back, and I write the runbook before the incident rather than after it. I would rather name a gap plainly than round it up: I have used Kubernetes in production for two years, not more.
I live in Lyon, speak French and English, and can work from your office two days a week.
I would welcome a conversation about your platform roadmap.
